content: Aɣelleb x Abcalum d řmewt nnes
Isedd Dawud řgens nni tuɣa ɣares iǧan u igga xasen imeqqranen x wařef d imeqqranen x mya.

Dawud issekk řgens. Ict n tuřut zzaysen sadu ufus n Yuwab, ict n ttuřut sadu ufus n Abicay, mmis n Ṣaruya, umas n Yuwab, d ict n tuřut sadu afus n Ittay, zi Jat. Inna ujeǧid i řgens: “Uřa d necc ad akidwem ffɣeɣ ɣar umenɣi.”

Maca řgens inna: “Cek war kidneɣ teffɣeḍ ca ɣar umenɣi, maɣar mařa neccin narweř s tidett, war kidneɣ řehhin. Mařa azyen zzayneɣ immut, war kidneɣ řehhin. Maɣar cek řexxu tsekkwʷid am ɛecra n řuřuf zzayneɣ. S uyenni řexxu mlih, mařa cek ad aneɣ tewced afus zi tendint.”
Xenni inna asen ujeǧid: “Necc ad ggeɣ min tᵉttwařam mliḥ di tiṭṭawin nwem!” Ajeǧid ibedd ɣar tewwart n tendint u marra řgens iffeɣ s řmyawat d řuřuf.
Yumur ujeǧid i Yuwab, Abicay d Ittay: “Egg s uḥaweř ak-d uḥudri, ak-d Abcalum, di ṭṭweɛ inu.” Marra řgens isřa i ujeǧid am yumur marra imeqqranen x Abcalum.
Řgens iffeɣ ɣar iyyar, ɣar umsagar ak-d Israil. Amenɣi ikkar deg wezɣar n Ifrayim.
Ttwaɣellben din iryazen n řgens n Israil zzat i wudem n imsexxaren n Dawud. Deg wass nni temsar din ict n tecti tameqqrant ařami wḍan ɛicrin-ařef n yeryazen.
Amenɣi iffeɣ ssenni di marra jjwayeh. Deg wass nni isarḍ wezɣar iryazen zi řgens ktar zeg inni isarḍ ssif.

Imsar Abcalum ibedd tiṭṭ di tiṭṭ ak-d imsexxaren n Dawud. Abcalum inya x ijj n userdun. Umi aserdun yuyur sadu řefruɛ imcubbcen n yict n tcejjart n yigg ameqqran, innuɣ netta s uzeǧif nnes di tcejjart n yigg ařami iqqim ittennuyeř jar ujenna d temmurt d userdun yuyur swadday nnes.
Ijj n weryaz iẓra i-t, iḥaja t i Yuwab, inna: “Xzar, necc ẓriɣ Abcalum yuyeř ɣar ict n tcejjart n yigg.”
Inna Yuwab i weryaz i d as iḥajan aya: “Xzar, cek teẓrid t, mayemmi war t teẓwiḍed ca dinni ɣar temmurt? Xenni iři necc ad ac wceɣ ɛecra n uqiyyat n nnuqart d ijj n webyas!”

Inna weryaz i Yuwab: “War wezzneɣ uřa d ařef n uqiyyat n nnuqart deg ifassen inu, war sswiẓẓiḍeɣ afus inu x mmis n ujeǧid, maɣar ajeǧid yumur i cek d Abicay d Ittay deg imezzuɣen n řgens, inna: ‘Ejj kuř ijj ad iḥḍa x uḥuḍri Abcalum!’
Mařa necc ad ggeɣ s řɣecc ak-d řeɛmar nnes - aqa i ujeǧid war teqqim uřa d ict n řḥajjet txemmeř - xenni cek ad xafi tekkared.”
Xenni inna Yuwab: “Necc war xak ttrajiɣ.” U netta iksi třata n lansat, ijju as tent deg wuř n Abcalum, am netta ɛad yuyeř iddar di řwesṭ n tcejjart n yigg.
Ɛecra n imsexxaren inni d as yarebbun řesnaḥ i Yuwab, nnḍen as uca wtin Abcalum, nɣin t.
Xenni isuḍ Yuwab deg uyicc n icarri uca iɛqeb-dd řgens marra zeg weḍfar n Israil, minzi Yuwab ixs ad iḥaweř x řgens.
Nitni ksin Abcalum, nḍaren t deg wezɣar di tesraft tuǧeɣ u ssarbun xas ijj n uɛurric n yeẓra imɣar aṭṭas. Marra Israil iṭṭef di tarewřa, kuř aryaz ɣar uqiḍun nnes.

Umi tuɣa iddar, iksi Abcalum i yixef nnes ijj n umayḍu iqeddsen, issbedd i-t di Teɣzurt n Ujeǧid, minzi inna: “Necc war ɣari bu mmi i ɣa isseɛqeř isem inu.” Netta iřaɣa as i umayḍu nni s yisem nnes. Ař ass-a qqaren as i umayḍu nni ‘afus n Abcalum’.
Xenni inna Aximaɛaṣ, mmis n Ṣaduq: “Ejj ayi ad azzřeɣ ɣar ujeǧid ad as ssiwḍeɣ řexbar aṣebḥan, aqa SIDI iḥḍa t zeg ifassen n řɛedyan nnes.”
Maca Yuwab inna as: “Ass-a war tessiwḍed ca řexbar aṣebḥan, maca deg ijj n wass nneɣni tzemmared ad tessiwḍed řexbar aṣebḥan. Ass-a war tessiwḍed areqqas d aṣebḥan maɣar mmis n ujeǧid immut.”
Inna Yuwab i Ukuci: “Uyur, ini i ujeǧid, min teẓrid cek!” Akuci ibendeq zzat i Yuwab uca xenni yuzzeř.

Xenni Aximaɛaṣ, mmis n Ṣaduq, inna ict n twařa nneɣnit i Yuwab: “Ad dd-yas wi ixsen, ejj ayi uřa d necc ad azzřeɣ awarni i Ukuci!” Inna Yuwab: “Mayemmi texsed ɛad ad tazzřed, a mmi? War ittwaf ɛad areqqas d aṣebḥan i cek, maḥend ad t tessiwḍed!”
Inna: “Ad dd-yas wi ixsen, necc xseɣ ad din azzřeɣ.” Xenni inna as Yuwab: “Azzeř!” Uca Aximaɛaṣ yuzzeř x webrid n udewwar n L’Urdun uca izzar netta Akuci.
Dawud iqqim jar tnayen n tewwura n tendint. Aɛessas igeɛɛed tazeqqa n tewwart i iǧan ɣar řḥiḍ, issgeɛɛed tamuɣři nnes, iceyyeɛ, iẓra ijj n weryaz ittazzeř, netta weḥḥdes.
Aɛessas iřaɣa, inna i-tt i ujeǧid. Ajeǧid inna: “Mařa netta weḥḥdes, xenni ad yaweḍ ijj n řexbar d aṣebḥan!” Yarni iqarreb-dd weryaz.

Xenni iẓra uɛessas ɛad ijj n weryaz nneɣni ittazzeř uca iřaɣa ɣar uɛessas n tewwart, inna: “Xzar, ittazzeř din ɛad ijj n weryaz nneɣni, uřa d netta weḥḥdes.” Ajeǧid inna: “Uřa d netta ad yaweḍ ijj n řexbar d aṣebḥan.”
Aɛessas inna ɛawed: “Necc ttwařiɣ amezwaru iggur am Aximaɛaṣ, mmis n Ṣaduq.” Inna ujeǧid: “Wa d ijj n weryaz iṣbeḥ, netta ad dd-yas s yijj n ureqqas d aṣebḥan.”

Aximaɛaṣ iřaɣa, inna i ujeǧid: “Řehna!” U netta ibendeq zzat i ujeǧid s uɣembub nnes ɣar temmurt, inna: “Ad ittwabarek SIDI, AREBBI nnec, wenni d ac isellmen iryazen nni igeɛɛden afus nsen x sidi inu ajeǧid.”
Inna ujeǧid: “Ma aḥudri, Abcalum, aqa-t mliḥ?” Inna Aximaɛaṣ: “Necc ẓriɣ ijj n ubarru d ameqqran umi Yuwab, amsexxar n ujeǧid, issekk amsexxar nnec, maca necc war ssineɣ min imsaren.”
Inna ujeǧid: “Ḥeyyed ɣar uɣezdis, bedd da!” U netta iḥeyyed ɣar uɣezdis, iqqim ibedd dinni.
Uca xzar, yusa-dd uřa d Akuci. Akuci inna: “Xzar, ijj n řexbar d aṣebḥan i sidi inu, ajeǧid. SIDI iḥḍa cek zeg ufus n marra inni xak iɣewwɣen.”
Xenni inna ujeǧid i Ukuci: “Ma aḥudri, Abcalum, aqa-t mliḥ?” Inna Ukuci: “Iři ad dewřen marra řɛedyan n sidi inu ajeǧid d marra inni xak iɣewwɣen maḥend ad cek ggen tuɛeffna am uḥuḍri.”
